levels.title: The Oracle Makes Things Up
intro: Hoo-hoo! I'm Pip, the library owl.
This is Orb, our magic answer ball. Orb is clever... but it answers WITHOUT reading any books.
Villagers will ask Orb questions. Check each answer against the real book page.
levels.goal: Press TRUE if Orb matches the book. Press MADE UP if Orb guessed wrong.

rounds.orb: The castle was built in 1850 by King Bob.

rounds.q: What does Ember the dragon eat?
How long does mango pie bake?
What is the brightest star called?
rounds.orb: The brightest star is called Sparkle.

levels.lesson: An AI that answers without reading can sound sure and still be wrong. This is called a HALLUCINATION. RAG fixes it by giving the AI the right book first.

levels.title: Find the Right Book
intro: Orb needs help! Before answering, Orb must READ the right book.
A villager asks a question. Three books are on the shelf.
Pick the book that holds the answer. Be quick!
levels.goal: Tap the book that has the answer before the timer runs out.

rounds.q: How many towers does the castle have?
When should I plant my seeds?
How do I know a potion is ready?
How long do cats sleep each day?

levels.lesson: This is the R in RAG: RETRIEVE. Before answering, find where the answer lives. Then the AI reads it, and its answer comes with a source.

levels.title: Magic Keywords
intro: Real libraries have thousands of books. Nobody can check them all by hand!
So the computer SEARCHES. It looks for the important words of the question inside every book.
Tap the important words, then press SEARCH. Tiny words like 'the' or 'is' don't help.
levels.goal: Tap 1 to 3 important words, press SEARCH, and make the right book win.

rounds.q: How long do carrots take to grow?

levels.lesson: Search turns your question into KEYWORDS, then gives every book a score for how well it matches. Small words are ignored. The top-scoring books are the ones the AI reads.

levels.title: Slice the Scroll
intro: Some books are long scrolls about many things at once.
If Orb reads a messy piece, it gets confused. So we cut scrolls into small pieces called CHUNKS.
Click the gaps between lines to place scissors. Cut wherever the topic changes.
levels.goal: Cut the scroll so that every piece is about ONE topic.

rounds.title: The Royal Diary
lines: A secret tunnel runs under the kitchen.
rounds.test: What does the king love to eat?

rounds.title: Forest Notes
lines: Rusty the fox lives in the forest.
Frogs sing loudly when it rains.
Frogs catch flies with their tongues.
Owls can turn their heads around.

levels.lesson: Long texts are cut into CHUNKS before searching. Good chunks stay on one topic, so search hands the AI exactly the right piece, not a messy mix.

levels.title: Catch the Fake
intro: Now Orb reads the page first. Great! But sometimes it still sneaks in a guess.
Each answer has 3 sentences. Two come from the page. One is FAKE.
Find the sentence that is NOT on the page and tap it.
levels.goal: Tap the sentence that the page does not say.

answer: Its walls are made of pure gold.
Ember sleeps for 100 years at a time.
A healing potion uses red berries and honey.
It glows green when it is ready.
It also lets you fly for a day.
A full moon comes every 29 days.
The brightest star is called Lumi.
The moon is made of cheese.

levels.lesson: Good RAG answers say ONLY what the sources say, and show where it came from. That's the G in RAG: GENERATE the answer from the retrieved pages, nothing extra.

levels.title: Build Your Own Oracle
intro: You've learned every part! Now build your very own Orb.
Write some notes (or use mine). Orb will cut them into chunks, search them, and answer from them.
Ask 3 questions your notes CAN answer, and 1 they CAN'T. A good Orb refuses to guess!
levels.goal: Get 3 answers from your notes, plus 1 honest "I can't find that".

templates.name: My Pet
templates.text:
My cat is called Biscuit.
Biscuit is orange with white paws.
She loves eating fish and chicken.
Biscuit is 3 years old.
She sleeps on the sofa every afternoon.
Her best friend is a dog named Momo.

templates.name: My School
templates.text:
My school is called Sunrise Public School.
School starts at 8 in the morning.
My favourite subject is science.
Our science teacher is Mrs. Rao.
The library has a big blue door.
Sports day is in December.

levels.lesson: That's the whole of RAG: CHUNK your notes, RETRIEVE the best pieces, and GENERATE an answer only from them. When nothing matches, say so. Never guess!
